channel.title: Coastal Eventures: upcoming events
channel.description: The next 40 dated events on the Gulf Coast.

item.title: 2026 USTA October Level 4 Open (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Sat 10/3 – Mon 10/5 · times not yet published | Mobile Tennis Center | No published price. A USTA Level 4 open draws roughly 200 players from around the country to the Mobile Tennis Center over three days. Match times and any spectator admission are not published on the host page, and the host's own address for the venue misspells the street name that USTA's own venue contact page corrects to Gaillard Drive.

item.title: Ballet Pensacola: Frankenstein (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Fri 10/2 7 PM · Sat 10/3 1:30 PM and 7 PM · Sun 10/4 1:30 PM | Ballet Pensacola, The Center | No published price. A gothic, atmospheric Frankenstein ballet plays one October weekend, October 2-4, a moody, elegant date. Bonus for a young dance fan: a matinee could work too.

item.title: Game Days at Marina Bar & Grill (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Thursday 10/1 | Marina Bar & Grill, Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort | No published price. Marina Bar & Grill at Baytowne Marina runs its own Game Days program, showing NCAA football on Saturdays and NFL games on Sundays plus select Monday and Thursday nights. It sits right on the marina at Sandestin.

item.title: Jazz Art Writers South Festival Youth Exhibit (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Tuesday 9/15 | West Regional Library | No published price. West Regional Library hosts this youth exhibition tied to the Jazz Art Writers South Festival, a partnership between Mobile Arts Council and Amp Up Arts. More than 50 paintings by artists ages 8 to 18 line the space, each interpreting jazz through color and line. No viewing hours are published for Tuesday, September 15, so call the library to confirm.

item.title: Karaoke & DJ Nights: FUBAR Pizza Bar (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Nightly · 9 PM-1 AM | FUBAR Pizza Bar | Free. Late-night karaoke runs five nights a week (Sun, Tue, Wed, Fri, Sat) plus a DJ on Monday and Thursday, 9 PM to 1 AM every night, with pizza till close. It is in Fort Walton Beach.

item.title: Live Music: Manci's Antique Club (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Thu 6:30 PM · Fri-Sat 7:30 PM · Sun 6:00 PM | Manci's Antique Club | Free. This Daphne institution has walls of Jim Beam decanters and live local bands Thursday through Sunday. It is a grown-up night out.

item.title: Live Music: Paradise Bar & Grill (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Tue/Fri/Sat 5:30 PM · Sun 2:30 PM | Paradise Bar & Grill | Free. Beachside live music plays most nights on Pensacola Beach, with rotating local acts starting at 5:30 (Sundays 2:30). Wine Down Wednesday runs $3 house and $6 premium wines all day.

item.title: Make It Last: Gallery Exhibition at UWF (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Weekdays through 11/20 · 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM · opening reception Thursday 10/8 · 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM | UWF Center for Fine and Performing Arts, Building 82, The Art Gallery | Free. Make It Last is an exhibition in The Art Gallery at the UWF Center for Fine and Performing Arts, curated by a UWF graduate. Six artists share the space, which includes a conversation pit in the gallery alcove and a poetry wall that visitors fill with their own work. Admission is free, and the opening reception on October 8 runs from 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM.

item.title: MONOCHROME exhibition (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Saturday 10/3 to Saturday 10/24 · times not posted | Blue Morning Gallery | No published price. Monochrome is a group show by three artists at Blue Morning Gallery, 21 S. Palafox Place in downtown Pensacola, running through Saturday, October 24. The black-and-white work asks what you notice, such as shadow angles, line curves and surface grain. The First Friday reception was October 2 and has passed.

item.title: Nuts and Butts Festival (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Friday 10/2 through Sunday 10/4 · all day | Coastal County Brewing Company | No published price. Coastal County's pork and peanut festival runs three days in the beer garden. It is all day Friday through Sunday on the brewery's own calendar. No admission is published.

item.title: Painting with a Twist Pensacola: paint-and-sip, family paint days and date nights (weekly programme) (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Classes most days: family days Saturday 10:30 AM, brunch Sunday 11 AM, evenings Wednesday to Saturday | Painting with a Twist Pensacola | $35 per family. Painting with a Twist Pensacola is an artist-led paint-and-sip studio at 4771 Bayou Blvd Suite C11 with several classes every week. October has family paint days (ages 6 and up with a parent, no alcohol), adult Paint & Sip and Date Night classes (ages 16 and up on date nights), Halloween-themed canvases and Paint Your Pet. Classes cost $35-$60 depending on the class, and alcohol is sold on site with no BYOB.

item.title: Pensacola Beach Songwriters Festival (cherry-pick sets) (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Oct 1-11 · venue-by-venue schedule | 22+ venues, Pensacola Beach + downtown | Free. Ten days of acoustic storyteller rounds run, mostly free, a build-your-own date. Many venues are bars; the cleaner picks are the daytime Gulfside Pavilion sets and restaurant listening rooms (Native Café, Flounders dinner sets).

item.title: Primal Fear Haunted Attraction at OWA (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Select nights through October 31 · evenings | OWA Parks & Resort | No published price. OWA's immersive haunted attraction runs on select nights through the end of October, with dates including September 25 to 26 and October 2 to 3, 9 to 10, 16 to 17 and 19 to 31. A $7 Zombie Laser Tag add-on is available alongside the main attraction, and tickets are required.

item.title: South Alabama Comic Con (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Saturday 10/3 · 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM · Sunday 10/4 · 11:00 AM to 5:00 PM | Mobile Convention Center | from $30. South Alabama Comic Con fills the Mobile Convention Center for two days with guests from film, television, anime and comics, plus cosplay, artist and vendor booths, and gaming. The show includes a costume contest, guest Q&As and fan panels. Children ten and under get in free with a paid adult, limited to two children per adult ticket. Autographs and photo ops cost extra, and every bag is searched at the door.

item.title: Wanda Sullivan: Bloem Exhibition (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Now through December 11 | Anna Lamar Switzer Center for Visual Arts | No published price. A gallery exhibition by artist Wanda Sullivan runs at Pensacola State College's visual arts center through mid-December. The center's own site does not publish an admission price.

item.title: Weekend Live Music: Sandshaker Lounge (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Every weekend · evenings | Sandshaker Lounge | Free. The Shaker, birthplace of the Bushwacker, has live music every weekend and never a cover. It is a classic Pensacola Beach dive, about 25 minutes from the bridge.

item.title: Take a Kid Fishing Day: Okaloosa Island Pier (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Sun 10/04/2026 · 7:00 AM-4:00 PM | Okaloosa Island Pier | from $2. Kids twelve and under fish free for the whole day, the first hundred get a rod to keep, and the pier lends tackle to anyone who needs it. Bait is donated. This is the fourth year running, with vendors, games, and food along the deck.

item.title: 2026 ALA-CASE Fall Conference (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Sunday 10/4 · 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM | Perdido Beach Resort | No published price. Perdido Beach Resort hosts the 2026 ALA-CASE Fall Conference on Sunday, October 4, from 8 AM to 5 PM. Alabama special education administrators and education leaders gather for professional learning across the day. The conference returns every year.

item.title: Destin Fishing Rodeo: Rodeo Run 5K (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Sunday 10/4 · 8:00 AM (finish/awards time not published) | Clement E. Taylor Park | from $35. The Rodeo Run is a flat 3.1-mile course starting and ending at Clement E. Taylor Park on the Destin Harbor. It has separate runner, walker and open-runner categories. Kids and wheelchair participants are welcome, and the first 200 registrants get a T-shirt. Proceeds support the Miss Destin Scholarship Fund and local charities; awards follow at AJ's Seafood & Oyster Bar.

item.title: The Great Bellingrath Harvest (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Daily through 11/8 · 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM | Bellingrath Gardens and Home | from $11. Bellingrath Gardens and Home runs a fall festival from September 19 through November 8 with seasonal displays across the gardens, including the scarecrow exhibit and pumpkin displays. The gardens are open daily, and the general admission price applies. The events page does not list a separate price for the harvest, so the gardens ticket is the number to plan with.

item.title: Adventure Zone at Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Mon-Sat through Oct 31 · 9 AM to 6 PM | Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm | No published price. Steve's Farm has rebranded as Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm and opened a fall attraction in Walnut Hill with a corn maze, a giant slide, a kids' zipline, a jump pad, hayrides, a wagon train, a sunflower field and a pumpkin patch. It suits a family with small children who want a half day outdoors. The farm's own page does not print admission prices, so check the ticket page before driving out.

item.title: Pensacola Bay Ferry to Fort Pickens (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Sat + Sun · runs 9 AM-6 PM | Downtown ferry landing → Fort Pickens → Pensacola Beach | from $20. Boat + fort + beach without the car: ranger narration across the bay, tunnels and batteries at Fort Pickens for engineering-minded kids, then the beach stop. Strollers roll aboard.

item.title: Free Yoga in the Park at Bayview Park (SUN 10/4)
item.description: First Sunday of the month · 9:30 AM | Bayview Park (dock next to the dog beach, east of Bayview Senior Resource Center) | Free. Free Yoga in the Park is a one-hour outdoor class at Bayview Park in Pensacola, led by Breathe Yoga and Wellness Center with City of Pensacola Parks and Recreation. It meets on the first Sunday of each month at 9:30 AM, next on Oct 4, Nov 1 and Dec 6. All ages and levels are welcome, and it's free.

item.title: Coco & Crawlers (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Thursday 9/17 · 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM | Ben May Main Library, Youth Programming Room | No published price. This caregiver meetup in the Youth Programming Room at Ben May Main Library pairs children's play with a warm drink. It gives caregivers time to connect with each other. It runs Thursday morning from 10 AM to 11 AM, repeating on the third Thursday of the month, with more dates on October 15, November 19 and December 17. Registration is requested but not required.

item.title: Destin Fishing Rodeo: Daily Public Weigh-Ins (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Daily, Oct 1 – Oct 31 · 10:00 AM-7:00 PM | Docks behind AJ's Seafood & Oyster Bar | Free. Anglers competing in the month-long Destin Fishing Rodeo bring their catches to the scale on the harbor docks behind AJ's Seafood & Oyster Bar every day in October. The public is welcome to watch for free from 10 AM to 7 PM, and the crowd tends to grow with the size of the fish coming off the boats.

item.title: Sunday Market on Palafox (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Sundays · ~10 AM-3 PM | MLK Jr. Plaza, Downtown Pensacola | Free. The Sunday sibling of Palafox Market brings crafts, art, and prepared food. Confirm each week's market on their Facebook page before driving.

item.title: DiscipleStory (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Sundays 9/13 – 10/18 (of an 8-week class) · 11:00 AM (end time not published) | Crosspoint Niceville Campus, Room 912 | No published price. An eight-week Sunday morning class at Crosspoint's Niceville campus walks participants through identifying their own story, passions, abilities and role in the church's mission. The class starts September 13 at 11 AM; the campus newsletter does not publish an end time.

item.title: Summer's End at Quayside Art Gallery (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Daily through 10/5 · 11:00 AM to 5:00 PM | Quayside Art Gallery | No published price. Quayside Art Gallery in downtown Pensacola is showing Summer's End, an exhibition about the turn from late summer into autumn, through October 5. Four artists fill the show with changing landscapes, vacation memories and the amber light of late summer evenings. The gallery is a locally owned artist co-op with three floors of work by more than 50 local artists, and it opens every day from 11 AM to 5 PM.

item.title: Sunday Brunch with John Wheeler: Seville Quarter (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Sundays · 11:00 AM-2:00 PM | Seville Quarter, Apple Annie's | No published price. Brunch runs in the courtyard room while John Wheeler plays through it. It is a daytime date that ends early enough to still leave a Sunday afterward.

item.title: AIA Alabama Annual Conference 2026 (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Friday 10/2 at 12:00 PM · runs through Sunday 10/4 | Perdido Beach Resort | from $35. Perdido Beach Resort hosts the AIA Alabama Annual Conference 2026 starting Friday, October 2. Architecture professionals gather for continuing education, networking, a product show, awards, and social events. Full meeting registration is $495 for AIA members and $695 for non-members, with a $50 rate for young professionals and students. A spouse or guest can attend for $75, and children are $35. The conference returns every year.

item.title: Brunch & Rally (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Sundays · 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM | Pickleball at OWA | from $10. Pickleball at OWA runs indoor open play every Sunday afternoon, paired with a discount for anyone who shows a same-day receipt from Waffles R Wild. Open play costs $10 for nonmembers, members play free, and a Waffles R Wild receipt brings the nonmember rate down to $7. It repeats weekly, so today's session is one stop on an ongoing schedule.

item.title: Monthly Gym Leader Challenge (Pokémon) at Trinity Games (SUN 10/4)
item.description: First Sunday of the month · 1 PM-4 PM | Trinity Games | Free. The Monthly Gym Leader Challenge is a free Pokémon event at Trinity Games in Pensacola on the first Sunday of each month, 1-4 PM. Decks are mono-type, and each player adds one booster pack to the prize pool. Payout is the top 2 for 8 or fewer players, the top 4 for 9 to 16, and the top 8 for 17 or more. Rules are at gymleaderchallenge.com/rules.

item.title: Pokémon League at Trinity Games (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Sundays · 1 PM-4 PM | Trinity Games | Free. Pokémon League at Trinity Games is a free weekly play session every Sunday from 1-4 PM at the shop in Pensacola. Trinity Games is a Wizards-certified Magic and trading card store with open play tables. The shop also runs other Pokémon events.

item.title: UWF Women's Soccer vs Jacksonville University (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Sunday 10/4 · 1:00 PM to 3:00 PM | UWF Soccer Complex | from $3. University of West Florida women's soccer hosts Jacksonville University at the UWF Soccer Complex, part of the program's debut NCAA Division I season. General admission is five dollars, and seniors, military and visiting students pay three dollars. UWF students, faculty, staff, children under six and youth in uniform get in free. Tickets are cash only at the gate.

item.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Weekly Casual Play and Tournament (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Sundays · 1 PM | GameMasters Guild | from $5. The Yu-Gi-Oh weekly tournament is an Advanced Constructed Yu-Gi-Oh TCG event at GameMasters Guild in Crestview, every Sunday at 1 PM. Entry is $5 including tax. Every player gets an OTS pack, and top placers get more.

item.title: Navarre Fishing Rodeo (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Saturday 10/3 · 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM | Juana's Pagodas & Sailors' Grill weigh-in and awards site | No published price. Anglers spread out across the shore, boats, kayaks and the pier for the two day Navarre Fishing Rodeo, with a published Junior Division that keeps the weekend open to younger competitors. Weigh ins run Saturday, and Sunday adds a second round of weigh ins along with the awards presentation.

item.title: Make & Take Art: weekly drop-in art sessions (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Thursdays 8/27 through 10/15 (except Sept 8) · 3:00 PM to 4:30 PM | Mobile Museum of Art | Free. The museum runs a free Thursday afternoon art session most weeks, working through materials and techniques borrowed from artists on view. Projects range from geometric shape painting to a Basquiat-inspired dinosaur build. The printed schedule also lists a session for September 8, but that date falls on a Tuesday, not a Thursday, so check with the museum first.

item.title: Painting with a Twist Fort Walton Beach: paint nights and all-ages sessions (weekly programme) (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Classes most weeks: Sunday 3 PM, Monday evenings, Saturday all-ages open studio | Painting with a Twist Fort Walton Beach | from $27. Painting with a Twist Fort Walton Beach is an artist-led canvas painting studio at 255 Miracle Strip Pkwy SE, Suite B-8, in the Publix shopping center in downtown Fort Walton Beach. October has an all-ages open studio, Halloween sessions, a book-lovers paint night and blacklight painting. Standard canvases cost $37-$39, all-ages sessions $27-$60 and Paint Your Pet $57-$59, and the studio is BYOB-friendly.

item.title: Trip Down Memory Lane (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Sunday 10/4 · 3:00 PM to 4:00 PM | Brandon Styles Theater | from $25. Tribute performer Brandon Styles channels nearly 40 classic artists from the 1950s through the 1970s at OWA's Brandon Styles Theater. Expect impressions of Frank Sinatra, Tony Bennett, Neil Diamond, and Louis Armstrong. Tickets run $35 for adults and $25 for youth, though the youth age is not published.

item.title: Blessing of the Animals (SUN 10/4)
item.description: Sunday 10/4 · 4:00 PM to 4:30 PM | First Presbyterian Church Fort Walton Beach | Free. First Presbyterian Church holds a short outdoor blessing service for pets under the oak trees beside the church, with treats for animals and their people afterward. Leash or carry your pet for everyone's safety, since this draws a crowd of dogs, cats and whatever else the family brings. Parking is in the three lots beside and behind the church.
